prediction_column_note: the calibrated ensemble column; predictions.csv also carries pred_ensemble_raw, on which the light-below-0h reversal also holds
headline_finding: error is not monotonic in stockout exposure: light < 0h < heavy overall (26.9151 < 29.3556 < 46.8522 WAPE), the light-below-0h reversal holds in 10/10 demand deciles (10/10 on a zero-stockout-only demand basis) and on 6/7 test dates, and within the 28803 store-products measured in both strata light is lower for 56.0% (median paired difference -3.0615 WAPE points)
note: strata are NON-RANDOM subsets: stockout exposure correlates with demand level, promotions, and store practices. These figures characterize where the pooled error comes from; they do not validate latent-demand accuracy and are not bounds in either direction. The reversal refutes a monotone protocol-only reading of the 0h stratum, it does not establish a causal account of its own.
